text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Super Creek is looking over at me<n>with a sleepy
expression...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Mmm... Oh, Trainer, you're such a<n>sweet little
cutie-pie...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, I'm sorry. It seems I had my<n>head in the
clouds for a bit there...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: I need to get myself together.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
You work so hard to pick all these<n>races for me... I
need to try harder... to<n>win them...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Super Creek mumbles before slipping<n>back into her
drowsy reverie.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
...Have I put too much on her plate? I<n>might need to
rethink her race<n>schedule.
